detail_text: This is a pre-solicitation notice. This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal quotes.Â Solicitation, 36C24626Q0523, will be issued on or about 29 April 2026.Â The Department of Veterans Affairs, Salem VA Medical Center has a requirement for pharmacy carousel structural analysis.Â This is a one-time buy.Â Â Â Â Â Â This acquisition is a small business set-aside.Â The applicable NAICS Code is 541330 with a size standard of $25.5 Million.Â All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to Charlsi.Brooker@va.gov.Â Â Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.Â Â Â Â Â Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at SAM.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.Â
